had been dispatched to [roadway] driver near the accident location. upon arriving i found ofc's from other agencies on scene. i then took command of the scene. from what i observed unit 2, the pedestrian, had been laying down on the exit ramp of ih 10 w & [roadway] when he was run over by unit 1. i was told that unit 1 driver was [roadway]. i then [roadway] where i contacted the unit 1 driver. from what i quickly gathered from the driver he stated that he had been exiting off ih 10 w when he ran over something. he stated that at first he thought he ran over a deer, but when he stopped he saw that it had been unit 2 that he hit. i then proceeded to have fire/ems to go check on unit 2 passenger who stated that she was possibly hurt. i then had ofc turner (#432) who had just showed up stay with unit 1 driver and unit 1 passenger while i went back to the scene. i then waited for my supervisor's sgt cannon (#3355) and sgt guzman (#3029) to make location. while i was waiting ofc turner (#432) informed me that unit 1 driver had told him he had ""1 beer"" of budlight. i told ofc turner to keep an eye on him and if he thought he was intoxicated to let me know. i then spoke with both supervisors what was going on and what i was doing. the supervisor's then started collecting all of the units that had been involved in. ofc turner then informed me that he done hgn and saw nothing but i then called for a dwi unit to make sure. i then was advised that tid det johnson (#2275) would be making the location along with campbell (#2102) who was on scene taking photos. i informed campbell of what was going on and what we had so far. i then stood by until the dwi ofc came and evaluated unit 1 driver. the dwi ofc stated that he did not find any clues and proceeded to leave the location. i then stood by as tid made location and then started processing the scene. upon looking at unit 1 i saw damage to the front bumper and undercarriage damage, matching what i had been told by unit 1 driver and passenger. i then stood by until tid was done and the medical examiner had taken possession of unit 2 to complete her investigation. i then completed the tsr's for the vehicles and then transport the unit 1 occupants back to their residents. i then gave them a [case id] and no further action was taken at this moment.**this report has been supplemented to include the toxicology results for unit 2 (pedestrian). the results were positive for alcohol, 0. 166 g/dl.

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the location for a motor vehicle v pedestrian accident. upon arrival to the scene i made contact with unit 2 who stated she was walking southwest on heimer while having the right of way when she was hit by a vehicle. unit 2 was in severe pain and was unable to give me much more information. ems stated she had a possible right lower leg fracture [medical facility] by medic 31. i then made contact with unit 1 driver who stated he was driving northeast bound on heimer and about to turn southeast onto brook hollow. unit 1 driver stated he had a red light so he stopped and looked to his left to make sure he was clear to turn. driver stated while turning he could not see unit 2 until it was too late due to the telephone pole and low lighting at the corner. driver said unit 2 was struck by the front right corner of his vehicle and was unsure if one or both tires ran over unit 2. i then made contact with the first witnessed who was identified as w1 in incident notes. w1 stated him and w2 (his passenger) were facing southwest on heimer at a red light when they noticed unit 2 walking on the crosswalk while she had the right of way. w1 stated they then saw unit 1 turn the corner and hit unit 2 with the front right corner of his car on her right leg. w1 stated they then pulled onto brook hollow to standby until police arrived. tid detective angell #2166 was notified of the situation and advised me to do a motor vehicle v pedestrian crash report. sergeant wilson #3081 was already on scene and aware of the situation. there was a signal light and crosswalk sign at the intersection. coban body worn camera made available upon request.

records.public_safe_text: police responded to the location for a motor vehicle v pedestrian accident. upon arrival to the scene i made contact with unit 2 who stated she was walking southwest on heimer while having the right of way when she was hit by a vehicle. unit 2 was in severe pain and was unable to give me much more information. ems stated she had a possible right lower leg fracture [medical facility] by medic 31. i then made contact with unit 1 driver who stated he was driving northeast bound on heimer and about to turn southeast onto brook hollow. unit 1 driver stated he had a red light so he stopped and looked to his left to make sure he was clear to turn. driver stated while turning he could not see unit 2 until it was too late due to the telephone pole and low lighting at the corner. driver said unit 2 was struck by the front right corner of his vehicle and was unsure if one or both tires ran over unit 2. i then made contact with the first witnessed who was identified as w1 in incident notes. w1 stated him and w2 (his passenger) were facing southwest on heimer at a red light when they noticed unit 2 walking on the crosswalk while she had the right of way. w1 stated they then saw unit 1 turn the corner and hit unit 2 with the front right corner of his car on her right leg. w1 stated they then pulled onto brook hollow to standby until police arrived. tid detective angell #2166 was notified of the situation and advised me to do a motor vehicle v pedestrian crash report. sergeant wilson #3081 was already on scene and aware of the situation. there was a signal light and crosswalk sign at the intersection. coban body worn camera made available upon request.

records.deidentified_narrative: 20-501846there is body worn video of this incident. unit 8166. on january 26, 2020 i was assigned to work as uniform patrol for the amarillo police department. at approximately 0323 hours police responded to the 900 block of n. mirror for a vehicle versus pedestrian accident. while responding to the scene i noticed an update to the call screen stating that ams was already on scene and pronounced the pedestrian deceased. i arrived on scene at 0333 hours and took my department issued camera and walked to where the victim was. the fire department and paramedics already had a sheet covering the victim. i took pictures of the initial scene and of the victim. the victim was later identified as darayvion montrel todd (bm [date]). while i was taking pictures, officer anderson was comforting the girlfriend and friend of the victim and asking them what they witnessed. officer anderson told me that they said [roadway] after getting in an argument with his girlfriend at the [roadway]. when they went to follow him in the car they caught up to him at 9th and n. mirror. they then noticed a car that they believed to be a newer body style yellow chevy camaro with black racing stripes traveling at a high rate of speed north on mirror towards darayvion. they honked their horn and swerved at the yellow car in attempt to protect darayvion from getting hit but the yellow car went around them hitting darayvion. the yellow car then continued north on mirror without stopping to check on the welfare of darayvion. darayvion's girlfriend and friend did not want to write an affidavit at this time due to their emotional state but agreed to write one at a later time and were picked up by friends to leave the scene. traffic follow up and csi responded to the scene to help with the investigation. judge jackson also responded to the scene and he ordered for an autopsy for darayvion and called for a mortuary service to take his body. i remained [roadway] closed from other traffic while traffic follow up and csi conducted their work at the scene. once every one was done processing [roadway] up for normal travel and returned to service. i turned the pictures i took of the scene into the police department at the end of shift. nothing further to report. dixon 173301-26-2020 / 0940 hours**[date]**bac and drug results for pedestrian showed confirmation of both in his system. bac results were 0. 087 and multiple drugs were present in his system

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the above location for a major accident. upon arrival i spoke to sheriff deputy medina #2909, who was working off duty at the flea market at the above location. deputy medina #2909 stated that the incident had began and ended in private property. deputy medina stated that he was directing traffic where the incident happened. deputy medina stated that he had told unit 1 to stop and let pedestrians walk to the parking lot. deputy medina stated that he told unit 1 to proceed. deputy medina stated that unit 1 slowly proceeded forward at 2-5 mph. deputy medina stated that witnesses told him that unit 2 was crossing to the parking lot and had his hand in his face to cover the sun. deputy medina stated that due to unit 2's hand and the sun being in his face, he was unable to see unit 1 in front of him. deputy medina stated that unit 2 bumped into unit 1's front right door causing him to lose his balance and falling to the ground. deputy medina stated that the injuries suffered by unit 2 were caused by his impact on the ground and not due to him hitting unit 1. deputy medina stated that the vehicle was not at a complete stop but was driving no more than 5mph as he had just proceeded from a complete stop. deputy #1328 was also on scene and stated that he only saw the male on the ground and assisted with crowd control. unit 1 had no damage on the vehicle. when i arrived at the scene, unit 2 was being treated by ems. unit 1 was standing by giving information to deputy medina. i asked unit 2 what had occurred but unit 2 stated he did not know what happened and he could not remember. unit 2 simply stated that it all happened too fast. ems stated that unit 2 never lost consciousness. unit 2 suffered minor injuries to his head and possibly his leg due to the impact on the ground. unit 2's wife [medical facility] just to be on the safe side. i contacted det. villanueva #2580 from traffic investigation and reviewed the accident. it was determined that due to unit 2 not having life threatening injuries tid would not make the scene. dme activated.
